entities.summary: Cramlington is a new town and civil parish in Northumberland. It is 6 miles north of Newcastle upon Tyne. The name suggests a probable founding by the Danes or Anglo-Saxons. Cramlington is a town in Northern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
